intent.proves: The share of active products (masters and simple products) in the default language and in scope that name a manufacturer that exists reaches the minimum, in percent.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT ISNULL(100 * COUNT(m.ManufacturerId) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM EcomProducts p LEFT JOIN EcomManufacturers m ON m.ManufacturerId = p.ProductManufacturerId WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope}
